risk_contract: Risk arrays are TOTAL per-reading-unit losses at depths0..4. K multiplies channel per-element curves by actual arrived token count in each block; V sums channel losses.
allocator: Greedy lower-convex-hull prefix jumps plus feasible direct-depth residual allocation; approximate integer multiple-choice knapsack, not an exact optimizer.
nonmonotonic_curves: Original empirical curves are preserved. A worse intermediate prefix does not block a useful deeper prefix.
budget: Separate K/V integer payload ceilings; harmful or zero-gain reads remain unspent.
validation_scope: CPU/CUDA regression, all24 fitted E/B/R identities, C0..C3, streaming re-encode consistency, causal prefix, matched-total-cost caps, native36-layer smoke.
external_artifacts_required: Per-E/B/R fitted codebooks and basis assets
excluded_from_git: Calibration tensors and large fitted assets
formal_run_status: V1 outputs archived outside source control. V2 must be evaluated with a new protocol lock; V1 results are not mixed.
